name: FeatureGrid
description: Mortar marketing feature grid, using central semantic tokens.

props.title: string
props.items: { title: string; description: string; icon?: ReactNode; visual?: ReactNode; details?: string[]; action?: LinkAction }[]

contract.usage: Use unnumbered features for capabilities; reserve numbers for ordered sequences. Add visual evidence, concrete details and descriptive action labels when they help visitors evaluate a feature. Visual slots retain their own accessible labels and must not contain live customer data.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
